name: Bobcat Storage Lateral
monitor_reason: length: the 20.35 mi (EIA Aug 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 531, 12/16/20 in, FERC CP06-66/67/68, completed Oct 2008) is the sum of several short corridors, none reaching 25 km (15.5 mi). Also an operating storage hookup built in 2008, not a new project.
researcher_notes: Port Barre Investments LLC (Bobcat Gas Storage), Louisiana. A Federal Register notice of March 2006 describes the storage project with three pipeline corridors of 12, 16, 20 and 24 inch pipe totaling about 20 miles, and the later expansion notice of December 2008 shows the North corridor loop is only 9.96 miles and the West corridor loop 2.68 miles. The corridors are separate laterals, so no single one adds 25 km of new pipe. Not an existing GEM row under another name: P0306 Doosan Bobcat Pipeline is an unrelated North Dakota line. The later Bobcat Storage Expansion (EIA row 709, 12.6 mi, 2011) is also under 25 km. Route not researched.
